messages:
harper: RCA published for the session-state leak that impacted some customer requests during last week's canary deploy. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/session-state-leak-2071023456 (internal) :link:

harper: TL;DR — a race in the session cache compaction worker could leave stale references in the sharded index, causing ~0.4% of requests to read wrong session tokens under high GC/backpressure. No customer data exfiltration. Full timeline + dump samples in the doc.

ian: read it, thanks for publishing. the fuzz test we added caught similar pattern locally — will add to CI.

sanjay: action items summary from the doc:
• harper -> deploy hotfix (patch) to compaction worker (DONE)
• tayler -> add bounded retry around session reads (owner: tayler)
• ian -> add fuzz/CI jobs for compaction timing (owner: ian)
• ops-bot -> increase canary traffic gating thresholds until feature is hardened

ops-bot: hotfix deployment completed to staging at 07:12 UTC and to prod at 09:03 UTC. No regressions observed. :white_check_mark:

tayler: clarification — bounded retry = backoff capped to 250ms with jitter, plus a metrics tag so we can alert on elevated retries only. I'll PR today.

harper: additional follow-ups in the doc: 7-day quick sync (verify metrics & postmortem action progress) and 30-day checkpoint (validate no regressions under stress). Scheduling proposed times in the doc calendar embed. :spiral_calendar:

maria: volunteering to own the 7-day sync and capture minutes. tagging eng-oncall for extra eyes.

eng-oncall: acknowledged. we'll leave the canary gating stricter for next 72h and watch: session.read_retries, compactor.ops, session.miss_rate.

sanjay: small excerpt of the log snippet that helped root cause:
```
2026-09-14T06:42:11Z compactor[worker-3]: compact:start shard=17 id=0x4f2
2026-09-14T06:42:11Z session[read]: read start token=0x4f2
2026-09-14T06:42:11Z compactor[worker-3]: compact:remove ref=0x4f2 -> raced
```

harper: please add any questions or blockers here. if you're owning an item, drop a quick ack + ETA. will post calendar invites after folks ack.

ian: ack — I'll have the CI fuzz job PR by end of day tomorrow.

tayler: ack — PR for bounded retry today, ETA 4pm PT.

maria: ack — I'll schedule the 7-day sync for Thurs 10am PT and add agenda.

sanjay: thanks everyone. great job catching this before larger rollout. will follow up in the 7-day sync with post-deploy metrics and handoff notes.

harper: closing loop — RCA doc link again: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/session-state-leak-2071023456 — please comment directly on the doc for technical edits. :eyes:
